h1: Medical device SEO for manufacturers whose buyers read the technical documents.
sub: A device manufacturer is searched by engineers checking compatibility, clinicians checking application and distributors checking the range. Medical device SEO builds the product, application and technical-documentation content those three read.
whatsapp_text: Hi, I'd like to discuss SEO for our medical device range.
persona: Marketing or product lead at a medical device manufacturer or OEM

paras: Medical device SEO for a manufacturer is different from SEO for a dealer. A dealer sells other people's products in a territory. A manufacturer owns the product, so the content that matters is the content only the manufacturer can write: how the device works, what it is indicated for, what it connects to, which consumables and accessories fit, what the interface and the specifications actually are.

That splits into three content types. Product pages carrying the real specification per model and variant. Application pages describing the clinical or industrial setting the device is used in, written for the person who searches by the problem rather than the product. Technical documentation content, meaning manuals, compatibility notes, interface details and installation requirements, published as readable pages rather than locked inside files.

We do not promise rankings, and we will not write a regulatory or clinical claim. Anything touching approvals, indications or performance is written from your own approved documentation and signed off by you before it is published.

items.q: Will you write claims about what our device is approved for?
items.a: Only what your own approved documentation already states, and only with your sign-off. We do not draft regulatory, clinical or performance claims, because getting one wrong is your liability and your reputation.

items.q: Should our manuals really be public?
items.a: Usually the parts engineers search for should be: compatibility, part numbers, interfaces and installation requirements. What stays restricted is your decision, and we structure the site so the public and restricted material sit apart cleanly.

items.q: How is this different from medical equipment SEO?
items.a: That service is for businesses selling other manufacturers' products in a territory, where city and stock reach matter. This one is for the company that owns the product, where specifications, applications and documentation matter. See medical equipment SEO.

items.q: Can this bring us distributor enquiries?
items.a: It can, by making the range and its documentation findable and putting a distributor enquiry route on the relevant pages. We do not forecast how many, because that depends on your category and market.

items.q: Our product team has no time to review content. Can you publish without them?
items.a: No. Technical content that has not been checked by someone who knows the device is a risk to you. We draft it, keep the review short and specific, and publish once you have confirmed it.

items.q: Do you also build device software?
items.a: Yes. Firmware, communication, companion apps and cloud telemetry are a separate service, written to your hardware spec. See product development. Hardware, PCB and certification are not offered.
